parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests must use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the task. Valid values:
- **1**: enabled.
- **0**: disabled.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the scan interval. Valid values:
- **day**: day.
- **hour**: hour.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The source from which the task is added.

parameters.name: TargetEndTime
parameters.description: The task end time, in hours.

parameters.name: TargetStartTime
parameters.description: The task start time, in hours.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description:
The task name. Valid values:
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: virus scan.
- **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan.
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: emergency vulnerability scanning.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The task type. Valid values:
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: virus scan.
- **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan.
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: emergency vulnerability scanning.
